Trace, implement and test: leetcode977 squares of a sorted array sort by abs

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> sortedSquares(vector<int>& nums) {
        vector<int> squares;
        auto cmp = [](const int& p1, const int& p2)
        {
            return abs(p1) < abs(p2);
        };
        sort(nums.begin(), nums.end(), cmp);
        for (auto& num : nums) squares.push_back(num * num);        
        return squares;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {-4, -1, 0, 3, 10};
    auto res = sol.sortedSquares(nums);
    printf("%d ", res);
    return 0;
}
